title: Nice manual grinder
text: Nice manual grinder. We ordered this to grind nuts etc. We wanted a wooden one since granite one is too heavy to handle and not easy to use on countertop. This is a sturdy one. A but difficult clean since it is a wood.

product_metadata.title: Forest Decor Olivewood Mortar and Pestle Set - Premium Wood Herb and Spice Grinder - Essential Kitchen Accessories for Fast & Efficient Herb Grinding - Wooden Chopper and Crusher - Smooth Small
features: 𝐌𝐔𝐋𝐓𝐈𝐏𝐔𝐑𝐏𝐎𝐒𝐄 𝐏𝐄𝐒𝐓𝐋𝐄 𝐀𝐍𝐃 𝐌𝐎𝐑𝐓𝐀𝐑 𝐒𝐄𝐓: The perfect way to grind up fresh spices and herbs for an evening dinner, or delicious guacamole for a quick afternoon snack, this wood mortar pestle set helps you add just the right touch to your meal.

𝐆𝐄𝐍𝐔𝐈𝐍𝐄 𝐎𝐋𝐈𝐕𝐄 𝐖𝐎𝐎𝐃 𝐒𝐄𝐓: Our wood mortar pestle grinder has been crafted with exceptional craftmanship by craftsmen. Each herb grinder set is carefully carved from selected olive wood. This makes the mortar and pestle wood set completely unique with long-lasting durability.

𝐃𝐄𝐄𝐏𝐄𝐑 𝐌𝐎𝐑𝐓𝐀𝐑 𝐁𝐎𝐖𝐋: We made the sides of our mortar higher; So our kitchen mortar pestle help prevent contents from spilling or falling out while you’re crushing using this pestle & mortar. This reduces the mess in the kitchen and helps you retain more herbs or spices.

𝐇𝐄𝐀𝐕𝐘-𝐃𝐔𝐓𝐘 𝐆𝐑𝐈𝐍𝐃𝐈𝐍𝐆 𝐏𝐄𝐒𝐓𝐋𝐄: This mortar pestle grinder is thick and durable; each wood pestle features a wide grip to give you more control over crushing, stirring, and mixing, while the round, wide head of wooden mortar provides a smoother, more even press against the mortar bottom.

𝐏𝐑𝐄𝐌𝐈𝐔𝐌 𝐇𝐀𝐍𝐃𝐌𝐀𝐃𝐄 𝐂𝐑𝐀𝐅𝐓𝐒𝐌𝐀𝐍𝐒𝐇𝐈𝐏: As a family owned and operated business, we focus on premier handmade craftsmanship which is why each wood mortar with pestle is beautifully unique in terms of color, pattern, texture, and even size for true exclusivity.
